pd_v3_dead.desc: v3: alarm + sit at the press while the head turns hard to the side and goes back; 1.4 s: head servos off + legs straightened over 1.5 s (gain 160): the duck rolls onto its back (tips 2.0 s, flat and still by 3.0 s, legs flat); 3.6 s: the legs come up over 1 s (hips -1.0, knees 1.5: the last twitch); death quack at 5.0 s, beak 0.3; holds the dead pose

pd_v3_flat.desc: v3, one stage: head servos off + legs to zero at 1.4 s (1.5 s ramp), the duck rolls onto its back with the legs flat; death quack at 3.8 s; no leg raise

pd_v3_legsup.desc: v3, legs straight to the dead pose: at 1.7 s the head servos go off and the legs go to hips -1.0 / knees 1.5 over 1.5 s; the duck rolls over and rocks for a while (still by 4.4 s); death quack at 5.1 s

pd_v3_dead_off4.desc: v3 pick with all FOUR head servos off (the roll too): the head hangs a little more crooked (roll joint 0.43)

pd_v2_faint.desc: v2: alarm + sit at the press while the head turns hard to the side (yaw 1.0 over 0.5 s), the head goes back at once (0.4-1.0 s), robot.relax at 1.4 s: the duck keels over backwards (tips 2.0 s, still by 2.4 s), robot.init at 3.0 s (2 s ramp: the head straightens, the legs fold to home), death quack at 5.5 s with the beak open 0.3

pd_v2_faint_late.desc: v2, a beat of suspense: same head choreography, robot.relax at 1.7 s (the head hangs back for 0.7 s before the cut), init at 3.3 s, death quack at 5.8 s

pd_v2_soft.desc: v2, softer lever: the head goes back only to -0.8 over 0.8 s, robot.relax at 1.5 s (probe: head 0.79 m/s instead of 0.90), init at 3.1 s, death quack at 5.6 s

pd_v2_slowback.desc: v2, slower: the head turns first, then goes back over 0.8 s (0.6-1.4 s), robot.relax at 1.8 s, init at 3.4 s, death quack at 5.9 s

pd_faint.desc: shock (head up, sit at once), the head goes back and to the side over 1 s, soften at 2.2 s: the duck keels over backwards on its own weight as the torque dies (tips ~3.2 s, still by ~4.5 s), death quack at 4.8 s, beak barely open

pd_faint_slow.desc: same faint, slower: the head goes back over 1.5 s, soften at 2.8 s, more silence, death quack at 5.6 s

pd_lean.desc: shock + sit, a body-pose lean back (-0.3, seated: the net moves the neck back) with the head to the side, soften at 2.4 s; the duck tips over ~1.3 s after the torque is gone (probe: the softest fall, but a marginal balance)

pd_legs.desc: shock + sit, head to the side, then the sit-stand RISE for 0.4 s (the legs straighten) and soften: the duck goes over backwards from its heels (the brief's idea; the fastest fall in the probe)
